reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Bear UI (https://bearui.com/).
Technology stack: react, typescript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 整站被 v1.3.3 弹窗压住，标题是 The Foundation for your React UI，点 Get Started 才进文档。侧栏先分 GETTING STARTED 段（Introduction、Installation、CLI、Theming、Dark Mode、JavaScript、Next.js、TypeScript），再是 COMPONENTS 28 段，按 Layout、Input、Form Controls、Pickers、Editors、Feedback、Navigation 分组，Button 底下还挂着 Speed Dial、Copy Button、Split Button 这些变体。右边另开 Icons 606、Registry Directory、MCP Server Soon 三项。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
